status.comment: Commit-reference and code-presence reconciliation reports are implemented and characterized; the optional LLM judge was cancelled as unnecessary duplication of active-agent review. Awaiting user acceptance.

reflection: Reconciled the parent: deterministic commit evidence works; the code-presence heuristic is implemented but honestly documented as low precision; ambiguous cases remain direct review work for the active agent rather than a new LLM-scoring subsystem. The intended read-only status hygiene capability is available without automating status decisions.
